title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Note 4 Segment Reporting: definition of the four reportable segments
key_points: AMD 在 FY2022 10-K 中列示四个报告分部：Data Center、Client、Gaming、Embedded。
Data Center 分部「primarily includes server CPUs and GPUs, DPUs, FPGAs and Adaptive SoC products for data centers」。
Client 分部「primarily includes CPUs, accelerated processing units that integrate microprocessors and GPUs (APUs), and chipsets for desktop and notebook personal computers」。
Gaming 分部「primarily includes discrete GPUs, semi-custom SoC products and development services」。
Embedded 分部「primarily includes embedded CPUs and GPUs, FPGAs, and Adaptive SoC products」。
除四个报告分部外，另设 All Other 类别，且明确其「is not a reportable segment」，主要包含收购相关无形资产摊销、股权激励费用、收购相关成本与授权收益。
分部业绩指标为 segment net revenue 与 operating income (loss)，由 CODM（即 CEO）审阅。
因分部结构调整，所有前期分部数据已做追溯调整（retrospectively adjusted）。
raw_excerpt: The Company's four reportable segments are: • the Data Center segment, which primarily includes server CPUs and GPUs, DPUs, FPGAs and Adaptive SoC products for data centers; • the Client segment, which primarily includes CPUs, accelerated processing units that integrate microprocessors and GPUs (APUs), and chipsets for desktop and notebook personal computers; • the Gaming segment, which primarily includes discrete GPUs, semi-custom SoC products and development services; and • the Embedded segment, which primarily includes embedded CPUs and GPUs, FPGAs, and Adaptive SoC products.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A: segment change effective Q2 FY2022 and FY22 segment results
key_points: 分部调整发生在 2022 财年第二季度，目的是使财务报告与公司管理战略终端市场的方式一致。
调整后公司按四个报告分部报告：Data Center、Client、Gaming、Embedded。
FY2022 分部净收入：Data Center 6,043 百万美元；Client 6,201 百万美元；Gaming 6,805 百万美元；Embedded 4,552 百万美元；合计 23,601 百万美元。
FY2021 对比分部净收入：Data Center 3,694；Client 6,887；Gaming 5,607；Embedded 246 百万美元。
FY2022 分部经营利润：Data Center 1,848；Client 1,190；Gaming 953；Embedded 2,252 百万美元；All Other 为 -4,979 百万美元；合计 1,264 百万美元。
Data Center 2022 年净收入同比增长 64%，主要驱动为 EPYC 服务器处理器销量上升。
Client 2022 年净收入同比下降 10%，主因出货量下降 24%（部分被平均售价上升 19% 抵消），平均售价上升主要由 Ryzen 移动处理器销售结构改善驱动。

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Item 1 Business: strategy, portfolio composition and Data Center segment scope
url: kb_demo/financebench/pdfs/AMD_2022_10K.pdf · p6 (Item 1 Business, Our Strategy / Data Center Segment)
key_points: 公司战略覆盖 data center、embedded、client、gaming 四个市场。

公司以 CPU、GPU、FPGA、DPU 组合提供芯片级差异化产品（semi-custom SoCs、Adaptive SoCs、APUs）与系统级产品（PCs、embedded platforms、servers）。

Business 章节对 Embedded 分部的表述为「primarily includes embedded CPUs, GPUs, APUs, FPGAs, and Adaptive SoC products」（含 APUs，与 Note 4 表述不同）。

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A Overview: FY2022 total results and segment growth drivers
key_points: FY2022 net revenue was $23.6 billion, an increase of 44% compared to FY2021 net revenue of $16.4 billion.

Growth drivers cited: 64% increase in Data Center segment revenue (higher EPYC server processor sales), 21% increase in Gaming segment revenue (higher semi-custom product sales), and a significant increase in Embedded segment revenue from inclusion of Xilinx embedded product sales.
These gains were partially offset by a 10% decrease in Client segment revenue due to lower processor shipments amid a weak PC market and inventory correction across the PC supply chain.
FY2022 gross margin was 45% of net revenue, compared to 48% in FY2021; the decrease was primarily due to amortization of intangible assets associated with the Xilinx acquisition.
FY2022 operating income was $1.3 billion versus $3.6 billion in FY2021; net income was $1.3 billion versus $3.2 billion.
AMD completed its acquisition of Xilinx in February 2022 and its acquisition of Pensando Systems in May 2022.
raw_excerpt: Net revenue for 2022 was $23.6 billion, an increase of 44% compared to 2021 net revenue of $16.4 billion. The increase in net revenue was driven by a 64% increase in Data Center segment revenue primarily due to higher sales of our EPYC™ server processors, a 21% increase in Gaming segment revenue primarily due to higher semi-custom product sales, and a significant increase in Embedded segment revenue from the prior year period driven by the inclusion of Xilinx embedded product sales. This growth was partially offset by a 10% decrease in Client segment revenue ... Gross margin, as a percentage of net revenue for 2022, was 45%, compared to 48% in 2021.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A: FY2022 product launches across Data Center, Embedded, Client and Gaming
key_points: In Data Center, AMD launched 4th Gen AMD EPYC processors and unveiled 3rd Gen AMD EPYC processors with AMD 3D V-Cache technology.
AMD introduced the 7 nm Versal ACAP VCK5000 development card, described as designed to offer leadership AI inference performance.
AMD announced availability of the AMD Instinct ecosystem, the new AMD Instinct MI210 accelerator and ROCm 5 software, positioned as exascale-class technology for HPC and AI customers.
In Embedded, AMD introduced the Ryzen Embedded R2000 Series and the Kria KR260 Robotics Starter Kit.

In Client, AMD introduced Ryzen 7000 Series Desktop processors on the new Socket AM5 platform featuring four new chipsets, plus Ryzen 7000 Mobile processors with up to 16 "Zen 4" cores and Ryzen 6000 Series Mobile processors on "Zen 3+" with RDNA 2 integrated graphics.
In Gaming, AMD unveiled the Radeon RX 7900 XTX and RX 7900 XT on RDNA 3, and added Radeon RX 6950 XT, RX 6750 XT and RX 6650 XT to the RX 6000 Series on RDNA 2 with GDDR6 at up to 18Gbps.
The 10-K does not mention Instinct MI300 or MI250 by name in this section.
raw_excerpt: For Data Center, we launched our 4th Gen AMD EPYC™ processors ... We introduced the 7 nm Versal™ ACAP VCK5000 development card designed to offer leadership AI inference performance. We announced the availability of the AMD Instinct™ ecosystem, the new AMD Instinct MI210 accelerator and ROCm™ 5 software. ... In the Gaming segment, we unveiled the AMD Radeon™ RX 7900 XTX and the Radeon RX 7900 XT gaming graphics cards that are built on next-generation high performance, energy-efficient AMD RDNA™ 3 architecture.

Adaptive SoC products include the Zynq SoC and UltraScale+ MPSoCs, which combine FPGA technology with a heterogeneous processing system, plus an RFSoC architecture with integrated RF data converters.
The Versal portfolio is composed of software-programmable Adaptive SoCs with a heterogeneous compute platform.
The 10-K does not state AI Engine throughput (TOPS), HBM bandwidth or logic density figures for Versal devices.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Trademarks and product brand list (EPYC, Instinct, Versal, Alveo, Radeon)
key_points: AMD's product brand for server microprocessors is AMD EPYC processors.
AMD's product brands for data center graphics are Radeon Instinct, Radeon PRO V-series, and AMD Instinct accelerators for servers.
AMD's product brands for Adaptive SoCs are Zynq-7000, Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC, Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoCs, Versal HBM, Versal Premium, Versal Prime, Versal AI Core, Versal AI Edge, Vitis and Vivado.
AMD's FPGA product brands are Virtex-6, Virtex-7, Virtex UltraScale+, Kintex-7, Kintex UltraScale, Kintex UltraScale+, Artix-7, Artix UltraScale+, Spartan-6 and Spartan-7.
AMD's compute and network acceleration board products are sold under the Alveo brand.

AMD's client processor brands include AMD Ryzen, Ryzen PRO, Ryzen Threadripper, Ryzen Threadripper PRO, Athlon, Athlon PRO and PRO A-Series; consumer graphics brand is AMD Radeon, professional graphics brand is AMD Radeon PRO.
raw_excerpt: Our product brand for server microprocessors is AMD EPYC processors. ... Our product brands for data center graphics are Radeon Instinct, Radeon PRO V-series, and AMD Instinct accelerators for servers. ... Our product brands for Adaptive SoCs are Zynq-7000, Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC, Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoCs, Versal HBM, Versal Premium, Versal Prime, Versal AI Core, Versal AI Edge, Vitis and Vivado. Our compute and network acceleration board products are sold under the Alveo brand.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Segment composition and Xilinx/Pensando consolidation into Embedded and Data Center
key_points: The Data Center segment primarily includes server CPUs, GPUs, DPUs, FPGAs, and Adaptive SoC products.
The Embedded segment primarily includes embedded CPUs, GPUs, APUs, FPGAs and Adaptive SoC products.

With the February 2022 Xilinx acquisition, AMD's portfolio includes FPGAs and Adaptive SoCs used in the data center and embedded markets; with the May 2022 Pensando acquisition, AMD offers high-performance DPUs.
Results of Xilinx are included in AMD's consolidated financial statements from the Xilinx Acquisition Date to December 31, 2022 and are reported under the Embedded and Data Center segments.
AMD's DPUs power the Aruba CX 10000 top-of-rack network switch.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Semi-custom design & development services with non-recurring engineering fees (Item 1, Business)
key_points: AMD 与客户共同开发差异化产品，这些产品基于其 CPU、GPU 与 APU 技术。
部分客户向 AMD 支付非经常性工程费用（non-recurring engineering fees）以换取设计与开发服务，并就最终产品另付采购价款。
该表述把 semi-custom 业务界定为「设计服务费 + 产品售价」的混合商业模式，而非单纯芯片销售。
raw_excerpt: We also work with our customers to create differentiated products that leverage our CPU, GPU and APU technology. Certain customers pay us non-recurring engineering fees for design and development services and a purchase price for the resulting products.

AMD 称其利用核心 IP（含图形与处理技术）开发 semi-custom 解决方案，并已将该协同开发方式用于多家游戏主机与掌机 PC 厂商。

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Customer concentration: one customer = 16% of FY22 consolidated net revenue (Gaming segment)
key_points: 单一客户占 AMD 2022 财年合并净收入的 16%。
该客户的销售全部来自 Gaming 分部的产品销售。
AMD 声明失去该客户将对其业务造成重大不利影响。
raw_excerpt: One customer accounted for 16% of our consolidated net revenue for the year ended December 31, 2022. Sales to this customer consisted of sales of products from our Gaming segment. A loss of this customer would have a material adverse effect on our business.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Risk factor: semi-custom revenue depends on third-party product success
key_points: 10-K 风险因素中明确区分「开发服务收入」与「semi-custom SoC 产品销售相关收入」两类来源。
AMD 的 semi-custom 收入能力取决于能否为 semi-custom 设计管线争取到客户、客户是否推进项目、以及产品是否被纳入客户产品。
semi-custom SoC 产品收入直接与第三方产品的销售挂钩，反映该第三方在市场上的成败。
AMD 声明无法控制这些第三方的营销努力，因此预期的 semi-custom SoC 收入可能无法完全实现。
raw_excerpt: development services and revenue received in connection with sales of our semi-custom SoC products to these third parties. As a result, our ability to generate revenue from our semi-custom products depends on our ability to secure customers for our semi-custom design pipeline, our customers' desire to pursue the project and our semi-custom SoC products being incorporated into those customers' products. Any revenue from sales of our semi-custom SoC products is directly related to sales of the third-party's products and reflective of their success in the market.

key_points: AMD 将 Vitis 与 Vivado 与 Zynq-7000、Zynq UltraScale+ MPSoC、Zynq UltraScale+ RFSoC、Versal HBM/Premium/Prime/AI Core/AI Edge 并列，作为其 Adaptive SoC 的产品品牌。

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — IP licensing: AMD may sell or license portions of its IP portfolio
key_points: AMD 在业务描述中声明：公司会不时出售或授权其 IP 组合中的部分内容。
该句出现在四个报告分部（Data Center、Client、Gaming、Embedded）与 All Other 类别的说明之后，表明 IP 授权不属于任一报告分部的主营产品线。
raw_excerpt: From time to time, we may also sell or license portions of our IP portfolio. In addition to these reportable segments, we have an All Other category, which is not a reportable segment.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Licensing gain of $102M in FY22 from THATIC JV licensed IP (MD&A)
key_points: 2022 财年 AMD 确认 1.02 亿美元 licensing gain，来自向 THATIC JV 授权 IP 的里程碑达成与特许权使用费收入。
THATIC JV 指 AMD 与第三方中国实体 Higon Information Technology Co., Ltd. 设立的两家合资企业。
2021 财年对应的特许权使用费类 licensing gain 为 1200 万美元。
Licensing gain 在利润表中作为营业利润内的项目列示（2022 年为 -102 百万美元，即收益）。
raw_excerpt: During 2022, we recognized $102 million of licensing gain from milestone achievement and royalty income associated with the licensed IP to the THATIC JV, our two joint ventures with Higon Information Technology Co., Ltd., a third-party Chinese entity. We recognized a licensing gain from royalty income of $12 million for the year ended December 25, 2021.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Note 7: THATIC license mechanics, royalty structure, and Entity List compliance
key_points: 2016 年 2 月 AMD 将部分知识产权（Licensed IP）授权给 THATIC JV，对价在若干年内按里程碑达成情况分期支付。
AMD 还按 THATIC JV 基于该 Licensed IP 开发的产品的销售额收取特许权使用费（royalty）。
AMD 将该项 Licensed IP 与特许权使用费收入归类为营业利润内的「Licensing gain」。
2022 与 2021 年分别确认 1.02 亿美元与 1200 万美元的 licensing gain。
截至 2022 年 12 月 31 日与 2021 年 12 月 25 日，AMD 对 THATIC JV 无应收款项。
2019 年 6 月美国商务部工业与安全局将 THATIC 及 THATIC JV 等中国实体列入实体清单，AMD 声明正遵守相关美国法律。
raw_excerpt: In February 2016, the Company licensed certain of its intellectual property (Licensed IP) to the THATIC JV, payable over several years upon achievement of certain milestones. The Company also receives a royalty based on the sales of the THATIC JV's products developed on the basis of such Licensed IP. The Company classifies Licensed IP and royalty income associated with the February 2016 agreement as Licensing gain within operating income. … In June 2019, the Bureau of Industry and Security of the United States Department of Commerce added certain Chinese entities to the Entity List, including THATIC and the THATIC JV. The Company is complying with U.S. law pertaining to the Entity List designation.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — AMD Advantage Design Framework as a partner collaboration, not a standalone sold service
key_points: AMD Advantage Design Framework 被描述为与全球 PC 合作伙伴的协作（collaboration），而非独立销售的服务。
该框架组合了 AMD Radeon RX 系列移动显卡、AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition、AMD Ryzen 系列移动处理器，并运用 AMD smart technologies。
其目标是交付高性能游戏笔记本与「best-in-class」游戏体验。
同一段落还提及 AMD Radeon Software 扩展远程能力，以及 FSR 2.0 上采样技术。
raw_excerpt: Our AMD Advantage Design™ Framework is a collaboration with our global PC partners, delivering high-performance gaming notebooks by combining our AMD Radeon RX series mobile graphics, AMD Software: Adrenalin Edition, AMD Ryzen series mobile processors and utilizing AMD smart technologies to provide best-in-class gaming experiences.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Software platforms & developer enablement as a strategic pillar; Pensando software stack
key_points: AMD 战略聚焦五大支柱，其中包含「提供软件平台与开发者赋能（providing software platforms and developer enablement）」。
另一支柱为「设计定制芯片与解决方案（designing custom silicon and solutions）」，对应 semi-custom 业务。
AMD 投资于面向游戏、计算、AI、VR/AR 市场的高性能 GPU 与软件。
Pensando 收购（2022 年 5 月完成）为 AMD 带来高性能 DPU 以及一套补充现有产品的软件栈（software stack）。

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Application engineering support and FPGA-as-a-Service channel
key_points: AMD 聘用应用工程师（application engineers）协助客户设计、测试与验证集成其产品的系统设计。
AMD 称其在所有主要云服务商中拥有不断增长的业务存在，这些云服务商提供 FPGA-as-a-Service（FaaS）。
上述两项属于随产品销售提供的工程支持与云交付渠道，而非独立计价的软件订阅业务。
raw_excerpt: We also employ application engineers to assist our customers in designing, testing and qualifying system designs that incorporate our products. / as well as a growing presence across all major cloud providers who provide FPGA-as-a-Service (FaaS).

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Warranty terms frame post-sale obligations as warranty rather than a services business
key_points: AMD 一般保证其售出产品在正常使用条件下一年内符合批准规格且无材料与工艺缺陷。
对某些产品类型提供最长三年的有限保修。
有时依据与特定客户协商的条款提供其他保修期。
申报文件将售后义务表述为保修，未描述为独立的服务业务线。
raw_excerpt: We generally warrant that our products sold to our customers will conform to our approved specifications and be free from defects in material and workmanship under normal use and conditions for one year. We offer up to three-year limited warranties for certain product types, and sometimes provide other warranty periods based on negotiated terms with certain customers.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Segment structure: no separate software/services/licensing revenue line
key_points: AMD 按四个报告分部披露：Data Center、Client、Gaming、Embedded，另有 All Other 类别。
Gaming 分部 2022 年净收入 68 亿美元，同比增长 21%，增长主要由游戏主机 SoC 需求上升带来的 semi-custom 产品销售增长驱动。
Embedded 分部 2022 年净收入 46 亿美元，主要来自 2022 年 2 月完成 Xilinx 收购后纳入的 Xilinx 嵌入式产品收入。
All Other 2022 年营业亏损 50 亿美元，主要包括 35 亿美元收购相关无形资产摊销、11 亿美元股权激励费用与 4.52 亿美元收购相关成本，并含 licensing gain。
申报文件未设独立的软件、服务或 IP 授权收入行。

The increase in net revenue was driven by higher semi-custom product sales due to higher demand for gaming console SoCs, partially offset by lower gaming graphics sales … All Other operating loss of $5.0 billion in 2022 primarily consisted of $3.5 billion of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, $1.1 billion of stock-based compensation expense, and $452 million of acquisition-related costs … and licensing gain.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — MD&A Overview: drivers of FY2022 revenue growth by segment
key_points: FY2022 net revenue of $23.6B increased 44% versus FY2021 net revenue of $16.4B.

Growth driven by Data Center +64% (higher EPYC server processor sales), Gaming +21% (higher semi-custom product sales), and a significant increase in Embedded from inclusion of Xilinx embedded product sales.
Growth was partially offset by a 10% decrease in Client segment revenue due to lower processor shipments amid a weak PC market and significant inventory correction across the PC supply chain.
FY2022 gross margin was 45% versus 48% in FY2021; the decrease was primarily due to amortization of intangible assets associated with the Xilinx acquisition.
FY2022 operating income was $1.3B versus $3.6B in FY2021; net income was $1.3B versus $3.2B.
raw_excerpt: The increase in net revenue was driven by a 64% increase in Data Center segment revenue primarily due to higher sales of our EPYC™ server processors, a 21% increase in Gaming segment revenue primarily due to higher semi-custom product sales, and a significant increase in Embedded segment revenue … partially offset by a 10% decrease in Client segment revenue

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Client segment discussion: unit shipments down 24%, ASP up 19%
key_points: Client net revenue of $6.2B in FY2022 decreased 10% versus $6.9B in FY2021.
The decline was driven by a 24% decrease in unit shipments, partially offset by a 19% increase in average selling price.
The ASP increase was primarily driven by a richer mix of Ryzen mobile processor sales.
Client operating income was $1.2B in FY2022 versus $2.1B in FY2021.
raw_excerpt: Client net revenue of $6.2 billion in 2022 decreased by 10%, compared to net revenue of $6.9 billion in 2021, primarily driven by a 24% decrease in unit shipment, partially offset by a 19% increase in average selling price.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Gaming segment discussion: semi-custom console SoCs up, gaming graphics down
key_points: Gaming net revenue of $6.8B in FY2022 increased 21% versus $5.6B in FY2021.
The increase was driven by higher semi-custom product sales due to higher demand for gaming console SoCs.
This was partially offset by lower gaming graphics sales due to a decrease in unit shipments driven by soft consumer demand amid weakened macroeconomic conditions in the second half of 2022.
Gaming operating income was $953M in FY2022 versus $934M in FY2021.
raw_excerpt: The increase in net revenue was driven by higher semi-custom product sales due to higher demand for gaming console SoCs, partially offset by lower gaming graphics sales due to a decrease in unit shipments driven by soft consumer demand given weakened macroeconomic conditions experienced in the second half of 2022.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Embedded segment discussion: Xilinx consolidation drives scale jump
key_points: Embedded net revenue of $4.6B in FY2022 versus $246M in FY2021.
The increase was primarily driven by the inclusion of Xilinx embedded product revenue following the February 2022 Xilinx acquisition.
Embedded operating income was $2.3B in FY2022 versus $44M in FY2021.
raw_excerpt: Embedded net revenue of $4.6 billion in 2022 increased significantly, compared to net revenue of $246 million in 2021. The significant increase in net revenue was primarily driven by the inclusion of Xilinx embedded product revenue as a result of the acquisition of Xilinx in February 2022.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Risk Factors: Intel's dominance of the microprocessor market
key_points: AMD states that Intel has been the market share leader for microprocessors for many years.
AMD states Intel's market share, margins and significant financial resources enable it to market products aggressively and to target AMD's customers and channel partners with special incentives.
AMD states Intel has been able to control x86 microprocessor and computer system standards and benchmarks.
AMD states Intel also dominates the computer system platform, including core logic chipsets, graphics chips, networking devices and non-volatile storage.
AMD states it competes with Intel in FPGAs and Adaptive SoC products.
raw_excerpt: Intel Corporation (Intel) has been the market share leader for microprocessors for many years. Intel's market share, margins and significant financial resources enable it to market its products aggressively, to target our customers and our channel partners with special incentives … Intel has been able to control x86 microprocessor and computer system standards and benchmarks … we compete with Intel in field programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and Adaptive SoC products.

title: AMD 2022 Form 10-K — Competition in Gaming Segment: NVIDIA is discrete graphics market share leader
key_points: AMD states that in the graphics market its principal competitor in the supply of discrete graphics is NVIDIA, who is the market share leader.
AMD states Intel also manufactures and sells embedded graphics processors and integrated graphics processor (IGP) chipsets.
AMD states Intel has developed its own gaming-focused discrete GPUs.

Intel also manufactures and sells embedded graphics processors and integrated graphics processor (IGP) chipsets. Also, Intel has developed their own gaming-focused discrete GPUs

AMD offers P4 programmable Pensando DPUs for data center infrastructure offload.
Data Center GPUs include the AMD Instinct MI200 Series based on 2nd Gen AMD CDNA architecture, paired with the ROCm open software platform, targeting AI training and supercomputing workloads.
